import numpy as np
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

# Test description: x1=[np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf], x2=[np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf] (all float dtypes, broadcast)

x1 = [np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf]
x2 = [np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf]

# Test with all float dtypes
float_dtypes = [np.float32, np.float64]

try:
    results = {}
    for dtype in float_dtypes:
        x1_arr = np.array(x1, dtype=dtype)
        x2_arr = np.array(x2, dtype=dtype)
        
        # Convert to jax arrays for operations
        x1_jax = jnp.array(x1_arr)
        x2_jax = jnp.array(x2_arr)
        
        # Test broadcasting - perform element-wise operations
        # Test addition as a basic operation that should broadcast
        result_add = jnp.add(x1_jax, x2_jax)
        results[f"add_{dtype.__name__}"] = result_add
        
        # Test multiplication
        result_mul = jnp.multiply(x1_jax, x2_jax)
        results[f"mul_{dtype.__name__}"] = result_mul
    
    # Record the result with the exact description text
    probe("x1=[np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf], x2=[np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf] (all float dtypes, broadcast)", results)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception("x1=[np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf], x2=[np.nan, -np.inf, -1, 0, 1, np.inf] (all float dtypes, broadcast)", e)
